standard_prerequisites.name: Composition of counits
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Categories, the lemma stating that the composition of the counits for f and f' is the counit for the composite
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the identification of the two composites as the same adjoint map.

core_obligations: Reduce to an adjunction statement (proof lines 8504-8513): going around the diagram either way gives the map adjoint to L(f' o f)^*(R(f' o f)_*K tensor^L R(f' o f)_*L) -> K tensor^L L, so it suffices to identify the two adjoint maps.

Identify through counits (proof lines 8514-8526): the composite L(f' o f)^*R(f' o f)_* = Lf^*L(f')^*Rf'_*Rf_* -> Lf^*Rf_* -> id is the counit of the composite adjunction by the composition-of-counits lemma, which shows that both ways around the diagram induce the same adjoint map and hence are equal.
proof_roadmap: Write both composites as adjoints of maps on pullbacks.
Use the identification of the composed counit to see that the two adjoints coincide, giving commutativity.

The proof (proof lines 8503-8526) expresses both composites as adjoints of a map on pullbacks and identifies the two through the description of the composed counit.
